required_concepts: E is the number of edges
acceptable_paraphrases: Twelve are the total edges in this shape
A total of 12 lines make up the boundary of the solid
misconceptions: believing a cube has more than 12 edges
assuming the shape is a pyramid instead of a polyhedron
grading_notes: Ensure that the student correctly identifies and states the number of edges, using appropriate notation. Acceptable paraphrases should convey the same meaning.
